title: PSALM 118:24 A MORNING PRAYER: THANK YOU, LORD, FOR THE GIFT OF THIS DAY
text: Open your mouth right now and say thank you. Not tomorrow, not when their leg changes, not when the report changes color. Right now, this morning, with whatever strength is left in your body, lift your voice and say thank you, Lord, for the gift of this day. Before you check your phone, before you check the news, before the enemy rushes to hand you the file he prepared for you overnight, let the first sound out of your spirit be gratitude because I need you to hear me clearly. The fact that you woke up this morning is not common. >> [music] >> It is not automatic. It is not because you are stronger than the ones who did not rise. Somebody went to sleep last night with more plans than you and did not open their eyes again. Somebody had money in their account, connections in high places, [music] children waiting for them at the breakfast table, and still did not see this morning. But here you are, sober, [music] breathing, in your right mind. That is not luck. That is mercy that refused to let go of you in the dark. I decree over you this morning, the same mercy that kept you last night is the same mercy that will carry you through today. You did not survive by accident. You are alive on assignment. There is a company of people this morning still carrying yesterday's file on their back into today. [music] You are still replaying the conversation that wounded you. You are still nursing the report that shook the ground under your feet. You are still standing at the grave of something that died last [music] month, refusing to leave that place. I have a word for you. Put it down. Today did [music] not carry over yesterday's account. Today is not an extension of your disappointment. Today is a fresh, sovereign, [music] deliberate act of God, and he did not consult your failures before he made it. Somebody say it out loud, right where you are. Whether you are standing, sitting, [music] driving, or lying in a hospital bed, this is the day. Not was, not will be, is. The word of God settles it in Psalm 118:24. This is the day which the Lord hath made. We will rejoice and be glad in it. Notice what the verse did not say. It did not say this will become a good [music] day if nothing goes wrong. It did not say this is the day the Lord will make if you behave well enough to deserve it. It says this I is the day the Lord has made, finished, sealed, delivered, and before you even open your eyes, heaven had already completed the work of building this day for you. He did not consult your enemies before he made it. He did not send it to committee for approval from the people who wrote you off. He made the day himself and he handed it to you already blessed, already covered, already loaded with purpose, and the only instruction attached to it is this, rejoice and be glad in it. Rejoicing in [music] this house is not a reaction to good news. Rejoicing is a declaration of war against bad news before it even arrives. >> [music] >> Somebody shout it. I refuse to hand this day over to worry. I refuse to let fear write the headline of my morning. Something good is going to happen to me today in the name of Jesus. And it is not only the psalmist who understood the weight of a morning. The prophet Jeremiah, standing in the middle of a city under judgment, watching everything he knew collapse around him, still found strength to [music] write in Lamentations chapter 3:22 and 23. It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed [music] because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness. [music] Hear what that man is telling you. Mercy is not a one-time transaction that happened the day you got saved and is expected to stretch across the rest of your life on reserve. Mercy is a morning supply. Every single sunrise, before the light climbs over the roof of your house, heaven issues a fresh delivery. [music] Not leftover mercy. Not mercy with yesterday's mistake still attached to it like a receipt. New mercy. That means whatever door you open that you should not have opened, whatever prayer you failed to pray, whatever weakness got the better of you yesterday, this morning supply did not check your file before it was released to you. [music] God is not managing you by your history. He's meeting you by his compassion. And that compassion resets every 24 [music] hours, whether you feel worthy of it or not. This is why the man who wrote Psalm 118 [music] could stand in front of an entire nation and command them to rejoice. He understood something about the character of God. [music] God does not make junk days. He does not throw dice in heaven and hand you whatever falls out. >> [music] >> Every day is a made day, engineered on purpose, released with your name already written into its assignment. There is an appointment in today with your breakthrough. There is a conversation coming that will shift something. There is a phone call, a document, a face you have not yet seen that today is already carrying toward you. I decree that today is pregnant [music] with your breakthrough. I decree that the sun that rose over your roof this morning did not rise by coincidence. It rose on assignment. This day carries the fingerprints of your destiny in its very atmosphere. David understood this so deeply that he made it a discipline. [music] He said in Psalm 5:3, "My voice shall thou hear in the morning, O Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up." He did not wait for the day to prove itself before he prayed. He prayed first before the day had a chance to hand him anything, good or bad. Because he knew that whoever gets [music] to speak into the atmosphere first sets the tone for everything that follows. >> [music] >> If you let the news speak first, the news will set your tone. If you let your bank balance speak first, your [music] bank balance will set your tone. But if you speak first, if you pray first, [music] if you thank God first, you have already claimed the microphone before the enemy gets a chance to grab it. The same David said in another place, Psalm 143:8, [music] "Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning, for in thee do I trust. Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk, for I lift up my soul unto [music] thee." That is not a man asking for a comfortable feeling. That is a man asking God to load his instructions for the day into the very [music] first hour before the noise of the world drowns out the voice of heaven. So, this morning before the demands of your household, your office, your business, your ministry begin to shout at you, I charge you, let the loudest voice you hear today be the voice of God's lovingkindness [music] over your life. Somebody needs to hear this next part with your whole spirit. Moses, the man who spoke with God face-to-face, the way a man speaks to his friend, prayed a strange [music] prayer in Psalm 90:12. He said, "So, teach us to number our days that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom." [music] He did not ask God to add more days to his life. He asked God to teach him to count the ones he already had. This is where many of us have been missing [music] it. We keep begging God for more time when the real prayer this morning should be, "Lord, teach me [music] to weigh the time I already hold in my hand." Today is not an infinite resource, it is [music] 24 hours, and not one of them guarantees a repeat performance. So, before you waste another hour on regret, before you spend another hour narrating the failure of people who have already shown you exactly who they are. I charge you, number this day, count it like currency. >> [music] >> Spend it like a wise steward, not like a careless child throwing coins into the wind. I decree that no hour of this day will be wasted on what cannot [music] be recovered. I decree that this day will be spent on what builds, what heals, [music] what advances, and what glorifies God. When God wanted to start something entirely new, he did not sit down and study the darkness that was already there. Genesis chapter 1:3 tells us, "And God said, let there be light, and there was light." He did not negotiate with the darkness sitting on the face of the deep. He spoke. And whatever God speaks over a situation becomes the new address of that situation. This morning, I want you to do exactly what your father does. Stop analyzing the darkness in your finances out loud to everyone who will listen. Stop narrating the darkness over your marriage, over your body, over your children's decisions as though narration is the same thing as intercession. Speak. Say, "Let there be light in my business today. Let there be light over my womb today. Let there be light over the region of my life that has been groping around in confusion for far too long." Somebody needs this reminder before we go any further. Psalm 24:1 says, "The earth is the Lord's and the fullness thereof, the world and they that dwell therein." That includes [music] today. Today belongs to God before it belongs to your calendar, your boss, [music] your landlord, or your enemy. Nobody can lay a legitimate [music] claim on a day that already has an owner, and his name is not written on any of the demands trying [music] to pull you in six directions before breakfast. When you understand that today is his before it is yours to spend, you stop apologizing for guarding it in prayer first. >> [music] >> There is something fierce sitting right beside the verse we started with. Look at Psalm 118:17. I shall not die but live and declare the works of the Lord. The same man commanding a nation to rejoice over the day is the same man declaring open war against premature death. In the kingdom, rejoicing and warfare are not opposites. [music] They are twins born from the same womb of faith. You can thank God for the gift of the day >> [music] >> and still stand your ground against whatever the day's assigned destroyer has planned. So, say it with your chest, not with your lips only, I shall not die. Say it again, I shall live. Not merely exist, not merely survive from paycheck [music] to paycheck, from crisis to crisis, but live and declare [music] the works of the Lord with your recovered health, your restored marriage, your children walking in the fear of God, >> [music] >> your business that refused to die when everyone said it was finished. By the authority in the name of Jesus [music] Christ, I bind every spirit of premature death assigned against anyone reading these words. You will not die before your season of fruitfulness. You will live and declare the works of the Lord. Job, in the middle of his own storm, said something that changed the way I understand my mouth. He said in Job chapter [music] 22:28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing and it shall be established unto thee and the light shall shine upon thy ways." Not suggest, not hope, decree. There is a legal authority handed to the believer to speak a matter into establishment. [music] This is not magic, this is covenant. You were given dominion in the beginning and dominion did not evaporate when you got saved. It got upgraded. So, from this point in our time together, do not merely read the declarations in this word, [music] decree them. Let your own voice hear your own faith. I decree divine speed [music] over every delayed process connected to your life, every visa, [music] every contract, every court case, every promotion letter sitting on somebody's desk gathering dust, move in the name of Jesus. There [music] is a woman here this morning whose weeping has stretched far longer than one night. Some of you have been weeping for a season, weeping for a year, weeping so long that you have forgotten what your own laughter sounds like. The word says in Psalm 30:5, "Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning." Did you hear what that verse just told your spirit? >> [music] >> It told you that your season of weeping has an expiration clock >> [music] >> and that clock is set to morning. If you are still weeping past your appointed time, I declare that your morning has arrived. Whatever Pharaoh has held you at the Red Sea of your tears long enough, I command his hand to open. I decree that this is your morning, not next year, not when the situation finally makes sense [music] to you. Now, joy is scheduled to arrive at your address today. Let us move into a quieter place [music] for a moment because not everyone reading this is in a shouting posture this morning and God is not only found in the noise. >> [music] >> Some of you are simply tired. Not dramatic, not in crisis, just tired. The kind of tired that sleep does not fix. If that is you, I am not going to hand you another list of demands. I am going to remind you [music] that the same God who fed Elijah under the juniper tree when he had nothing left to give did not lecture [music] him first. He let him sleep. He fed him twice. He let the process of restoration happen gently before he ever sent him back out to the mountain. So, breathe. [music] God is not disappointed in your exhaustion. He is near to it. The prophet Isaiah gives us a picture worth carrying into this day. Isaiah chapter 60 verse 1 says, "Arise, shine, for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee." Notice the order arise first, shine second. You are not asked to manufacture your own light before you stand up. You are asked to stand up because the light has already come and is already resting on you, whether you feel it in this moment or not. So, even in your tiredness, arise. Not because you have found new strength in yourself, but because [music] the glory resting on you does not depend on your energy level. Arise. Your light has come. The glory of the Lord is risen upon you this [music] morning, even in the middle of your weariness. For those of you whose morning still looks the same as it did a year ago, whose [music] prayer feels like it is landing on a closed ceiling, I want to leave one more scripture with you before we press [music] into prayer. Habakkuk chapter 2 verse 3 says, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, [music] but at the end it shall speak and not lie. Though it tarry, wait for it because it will surely come. It will not tarry." That verse was not written for people whose answer [music] came quickly. It was written for people in the waiting room, and it makes a promise that a delayed vision is not the same thing as a denied [music] vision. If what you are believing God for has tarried, this scripture tells you plainly that tarrying and lying are two different things. Your vision is not lying to you. It is simply not yet at its appointed time. Keep writing it. Keep watching for it. It will not be late. Now, let us move into the place of prayer, and I don't mean the kind of [music] prayer where you simply recite familiar words while your mind wanders elsewhere. I mean the kind of prayer where a hungry spirit speaks and heaven bends low to listen. Put your hand on your chest if you can. Feel that heartbeat. That heartbeat is not routine. [music] It is evidence that God is not finished with your file. Let's pray. And let's pray like people who understand that this day was handed to us on [music] purpose. Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the gift of this day. >> [music] >> And I bring before you every dream that was buried, every vision that was mocked, every assignment that was aborted by discouragement and delay. You said through your prophet in Isaiah chapter 43:19, "Behold, I will do a new thing. Now, [music] it shall spring forth. Shall you not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert." Father, do that new thing in my life today. Wherever my destiny was diverted >> [music] >> by fear, by wrong counsel, by a relationship that cost me years, by a decision made in a desperate season, [music] realign it now in Jesus' name. I decree that every gift buried under the rubble of delay is exhumed today. [music] I decree that the plans you have for me, plans of peace and not of evil, to give me an expected end [music] as you promised through the prophet in Jeremiah chapter 29:11, are made manifest starting from this very hour. Every road fashioned to keep me at the bottom when I was created for the top, I break you by fire. Your word in Deuteronomy chapter 28:13 declares that I am the head and not the tail, above only and not beneath. Father, arrest every satanic engineering that has forced me to function as a tail when you designed me to be a head, and I receive my head position back today. Somebody shout it. My destiny has an owner and his name is not my enemy. Every altar that spoke against my destiny before I was even born, I silence you now by the blood of the everlasting covenant. >> [music] >> Father, I bring my family before you now. My father's house, my mother's lineage, every child carrying my blood in their [music] veins, where there is a repeating pattern in my bloodline, a pattern of poverty passed from hand to hand, a pattern of sickness, [music] a pattern of broken marriages, a pattern of sudden and unexplained death, a pattern of confusion, I stand in the gap this morning and I say enough. The pattern stops with me. I did not come into this family to continue an inherited script. I came to close that chapter permanently in the name of Jesus. Every evil family altar erected before I was born, every covenant my ancestors entered [music] into in ignorance with powers that are not you, I renounce completely and I command your voice to fall silent [music] over my life and over my children's lives from this day forward. Let there be peace in my father's house. >> [music] >> Let there be reconciliation where there has been estrangement for years. Let the wandering ones find their way home. Let the elders in my family carry wisdom [music] that unites rather than pride that scatters. Father, gather what the enemy has scattered in my family in Jesus mighty name. >> [music] >> For every single person believing you for a spouse, let the divine connection locate them without further delay. Let every counterfeit sent to waste their season be exposed and removed before it cost them more years. Let the right one find the right one at the right time according to your will and not according to loneliness or pressure from from and friends. For every married couple reading these words, Father, I pray peace [music] over your homes this morning. Where quarrel has become the daily bread of that house, silence it. Where a third party has found room to interfere in a covenant that heaven joined together, expose them and remove every foothold they have gained. Where love has grown cold because of unmet expectation, unspoken wounds, and long-lost offense, rekindle the fire that first brought two hearts together under your name. I decree that no marriage under the sound of this prayer will end in a courtroom this year. I decree [music] restoration where there has been separation, and I bind every spirit of strife [music] assigned against covenant homes in the name of Jesus. Father, I thank you that you are Jehovah Jireh, [music] not Jehovah I will think about it. This morning I open my hand to receive what you have prepared for me, >> [music] >> and I stand on your word in Malachi chapter 3 verses 10 and 11, where you said, >> [music] >> "Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, [music] saith the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, >> [music] >> and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive [music] it, and I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes." Father, open the windows of heaven over my finances today. Rebuke every devourer that has been consuming what should have accumulated into my breakthrough, every fruitless labor, every leaking pocket, [music] every mysterious withdrawal, every contract that dies at the point of signing, every business struggling to survive a single season. I decree that this is the season of open doors, open windows, open accounts, and open hands toward me. Let money carrying my name, wherever it is sitting in this world right now, begin to locate me in the name of Jesus. >> [music] >> Let every gate assigned to close before I arrive at my breakthrough be broken [music] down ahead of my arrival. I decree that lack has lost its address in my life. Every gate [music] of provision that has been padlocked against me, I command you to open by fire in Jesus' name. Father, you are Jehovah Rapha, the God [music] who heals. This morning, I lift up every sick body reading these words, every diagnosis that has shaken a household, every pain that refuses to leave even in the quiet of the night. I speak health into every organ under attack. I speak restoration into every immune system fighting a battle it was never designed to carry alone. Whatever the medical report says, I decree a superior report from the courts of heaven over it. For the one waiting on test results, I pray [music] peace that guards your heart until the answer comes. And I decree that the answer will produce testimony, not tragedy. [music] For the one who has been managing chronic pain for years, I decree that today marks a shift, and even where healing does not arrive instantly, I decree [music] that the process toward your total healing begins now. Father, touch the mind [music] of everyone battling depression, anxiety, and thoughts too heavy to say out loud to another human being. Let your peace, which surpasses human understanding, guard their hearts and their minds this day. There is somebody reading this who has not been sick a day in their life, but who has [music] spent years nursing someone who is You are the strong one in the family, the one everyone calls when there is an emergency, the one who has not had the luxury of falling apart because too many people are leaning on you. >> [music] >> I see you this morning and I want you to know that heaven sees the toll this has taken on you. Even when [music] nobody in your household has thought to ask how you are holding up. Father, strengthen every caregiver reading these words. Renew the strength of every son and daughter who has become a nurse in their own home, every spouse who has not slept properly in months, >> [music] >> every friend who shows up for everyone else's crisis and has nowhere to put down their own. Let them find rest even in the middle of responsibility and send them help from directions they did not expect. Let every yoke break this morning. Let every burden shift. Let every heaviness lift off your shoulders in the name of Jesus. Somebody shout it with me. Today I am too blessed to be stressed, too covered to be conquered, too anointed to be defeated. There is a text in the Gospel [music] of Luke that speaks directly to what many of you have lost without even naming it. >> [music] >> Luke chapter 8 verse 46 records, Jesus turning in the middle of a crowd to say, "Somebody had touched me, for I perceive that virtue is gone out of [music] me." That woman with the issue of blood did not just receive healing that day. She caused a transfer. She pulled virtue, [music] strength, life force out of the master by her faith. But here is the flip side of that same truth this morning. Some of you have had virtue pulled out of you by years of carrying what was not yours to carry other people's burdens, other people's chaos, other people's unresolved issues that they dumped on your shoulders and walked away from. Father, I ask you this morning to restore every drop of virtue that has drained out of me through [music] disappointment after disappointment, through carrying weight that was never mine to carry, >> [music] >> through giving to people who never intended to give anything back. Recharge me the way you recharge Elijah under the juniper tree, not with another lecture, but with rest, with bread, and with a still small voice. Let my strength be renewed like the eagles, [music] and let this day mark the beginning of that renewal. Father, in the authority of the name of Jesus, I break [music] every covenant spoken over my life that did not originate from you. I break every curse traced to my father's house or my mother's house. I break every careless word spoken over me in anger by someone in a position of authority, [music] a parent, a teacher, a pastor, an employer that has since attached itself to my life like a shadow that follows me from room to room. Your word in Isaiah chapter 54:17 declares, "No weapon that is formed against [music] thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn." This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of [music] me, said the Lord. Father, I stand on that word this morning. Every [music] weapon fashioned against me in the dark, in dreams, on altars I have never seen, >> [music] >> in gatherings where hands that do not even know my face still know my name, I declare that it shall not prosper. [music] Every tongue that rises to condemn me in any court, physical or spiritual, I silence that judgment by the blood of Jesus. Let every evil altar where my name, my photograph, my belongings, or anything representing me has been placed [music] for manipulation be consumed by the unquenchable fire of God right now. Fire, go and locate every altar raised against my peace. Fire, go and locate every image fashioned to represent me for evil, I am covered by a blood that no fire assigned against me can cross. Father, release your angels to go ahead of me today. Your word in Psalm 91 declares, "He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty." [music] And continues, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep [music] thee in all thy ways." Father, I ask for angelic escort over every journey I take today [music] on the road, in the air, on the water. Let angels go ahead of me into every meeting, every interview, every negotiation, and prepare the ground before I arrive. Let angels stand watch at the gate of my home and the gate of my business this day. For everyone traveling today, I decree a convoy of angels surrounding your vehicle, your flight, your path. No accident will locate you today. No delay engineered by darkness will hold you back from your appointment. For everyone stepping into a room today where a decision about their future will be made, >> [music] >> I decree that an angel already sat in that room before you walked in and softened the hearts that needed softening. Father, expose every witchcraft assignment sent against my life, my [music] family, my finances, and my health. Wherever a gathering has convened to plan against my breakthrough, scatter that gathering the way you scattered the builders at Babel. I decree confusion in the camp of my adversaries. Let every arrow fired against me at midnight return to the sender with interest. Let every pot cooked against my destiny boil over and burn the hand of the one who lit the fire. >> [music] >> I plead the blood of Jesus over my body, my mind, and my dreams before the night even comes so that no summons from darkness will find access to me while I sleep. Every witchcraft gathering holding a meeting about my file this week, I command your table to scatter. What you have planned for my harm, I return to you as harmless in the mighty name of Jesus. Father, you said through your prophet in Joel chapter 2 verse 25, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust have eaten, the cankerworm and the caterpillar and the palmerworm." [music] Father, give me back the years the enemy has stolen, the years lost to sickness, to a wrong relationship, to a wrong job, to depression, to a prison built entirely [music] out of my own fear. Restore the time I spent fighting battles I did not need to fight if I had simply trusted you earlier. Let this day mark the beginning of the years being repaid, not just in feeling, but in visible, countable evidence. Father, preserve my going out and my coming in from this day forward and even forevermore according to your word in Psalm 121. Preserve me from evil. Preserve my soul from despair when the report is delayed. Preserve my family from tragedy. Preserve this nation from the violence, the accidents, and the chaos that the enemy has been planning [music] in the dark. Let your hand of preservation rest over every household connected to this [music] prayer, over their means of livelihood, and over their tomorrow. I decree [music] divine preservation over your body, your mind, your marriage, your children, [music] your business, and your name. What the enemy has scheduled for your destruction will not find you at the appointed hour. I sense something shifting in the spirit realm even as we come to this part of our time together. There are things I need to say that are not general, they are specific, and I ask you to receive whichever one belongs to you [music] and to release whichever one does not so that it can find the person it was actually sent to. There is someone reading this who has been praying quietly about a relocation, a change of city or country. That door is opening within this season. Do not sign the wrong agreement out of impatience. There is a woman here who has been believing God for a child for a long time, longer than she tells most people. >> [music] >> I see a testimony forming. Do not let the noise of other people's time line steal your peace. Somebody has an interview coming up that they have quietly written off as a formality. It is not a formality. It is your breakthrough wearing a disguise. There is a man here who has been seriously considering shutting down a business he poured years into. Hold on a little longer. The turnaround is closer than the calendar makes it appear. Someone reading this lost someone they loved recently and has been asking God hard, honest questions in the quiet. He has not left the room. He is not confused or offended by your grief. There is a young person here whose family does not understand the calling on their life. Do not abandon the assignment simply [music] because the people closest to you cannot yet see what God is doing. Somebody's paperwork stuck for months in an office you cannot even follow up on directly is about to move. Expect a call regarding it before the month closes. >> [music] >> There is a debt someone has been too ashamed to speak about out loud, even to people who love them. Grace is coming to close that chapter and it will not arrive the way you expect. [music] I see restoration coming for a friendship that broke [music] years ago over something small that was allowed to grow large through silence. Somebody here has been troubled by strange, unsettling dreams. The covering of the blood of Jesus is over you from this morning going forward. There is a pending legal matter weighing on someone's mind right now. I [music] decree that the verdict turns in your favor and that truth is exposed in that courtroom. [music] There is a student here about to sit an exam that feels like it would decide their whole future. Peace, [music] I say to your mind. Recall, I say to your memory. You have not studied [music] in vain. Somebody has been quietly grieving a version of their life that did [music] not turn out the way they planned in their 20s. I speak comfort over that grief and I speak [music] a new plan over what remains of the story. Let every one of those words find its owner and take root [music] in the name of Jesus. And for the rest of you who did not hear your specific situation named, do not conclude that heaven forgot you. God is not obligated to announce every single thing he [music] is doing before he does it. Some blessings arrive with no forecast at all. They simply show up at your door and knock. Before I release you into the rest of this day, hear the blessing of the Lord over your life. Numbers chapter 6, verses 24 through 26, >> [music] >> records it this way. The Lord bless thee and keep thee. The Lord make his face shine upon thee and be gracious unto thee. The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee and give thee peace. [music] That is not a wish. That is a covenant blessing spoken by God's own instruction >> [music] >> and it rests on you as you step away from this moment. Go into this day already blessed. Go into it already covered. Go into it with the confidence of a child who knows his father owns the entire house they are walking into. And whatever happens between now and the moment your head touches the pillow tonight, whatever the day tries to bring, do not forget where we started this morning. [music] This is the day which the Lord has made. Not the day the economy made. Not the day your enemies designed. The day the Lord made. So, let us rejoice [music] and let us be glad in it. Thank you, Lord, for the gift of this day.
